messages:
tess: Heads-up: econ preview for model-delta shows a persistent 25% lower cost vs ledger for 03/22 14:00-15:00. Quick sanity check before I dig in.
diego: Can you share the sample query you used?
tess: ran a small aggregation:
```
SELECT billed_sku, runtime_variant, sum(tokens) as toks, sum(billed_tokens) as b_toks
FROM invocations_sample
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-22T14:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-22T15:00:00Z' AND model='model-delta'
GROUP BY billed_sku, runtime_variant
```
tess: results: runtime_variant=quant-4bit toks=900k but billed_sku shows fp16 billed_tokens=1.2M in ledger sample.
ammar: that suggests double counting or mismatched token attribution between runtime and ledger. Any recent router changes?
diego: router v3.2 had late-binding that can swap runtime_variant after billing header is set. If billing reads header early we could bill fp16 while runtime ran quant.
console-bot: [ALERT] router-v3.2: header-reorder PR #4999 merged 2026-03-21T19:05:12Z
tess: We should: (1) backfill billing tags for affected invocations, (2) add a "billing_consistency" flag to the econ card, (3) nightly gate to fail batch-bill when mismatch > 0.5%.
ammar: Agreed. I'll open PR to emit canonical_runtime_sku from runtime and have billing consume that. Also will add the nightly gate.
diego: For immediate mitigation we can run a reconciliation job that joins invocation ids between the credit table and ledger and emit adjustments. billing, can you accept a request for credits adjustment workflow?
billing: Yes. Create a billing ticket with tenant list, window, sample invocation ids, and rationale. We'll queue manual adjustments and decide on credits vs future invoice credit.
tess: I'll run a quick reconcile job and post summary. Job id=recon-616800-01.
console-bot: [INFO] recon-616800-01 started at 2026-03-23T09:20:00Z
tess: Recon complete: found 1.9M tokens mismatched across tenants; estimated invoice delta $18,200. Filing billing ticket and placing a temporary banner on econ: "Some cost previews may diverge from invoices during routing transitions."
ammar: Will follow up with PR to runtime to emit canonical_runtime_sku and a test that validates router header parity. Also adding UI badge: billing_consistency = OK/WARN/FAIL with hover text.
diego: Good. Assigning owners: ammar=runtime PR, tess=reconcile + banner, billing=adjustment run. I'll put postmortem on calendar.
tess: Thanks team. Posting summary to #product after billing ticket filed.
